en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a corner multi‑story townhouse with ornate façade, balconies and shopfronts on the ground floor. People stand on the corner balcony and pedestrians walk along the cobblestone streets. Overhead tram or telegraph wires cross the scene. Printed captions in German at the bottom identify the location as a street corner in Meissen, and a small imprint notes the publisher and year 1905.
